initial_failure.fact: After durable intake of an exact resume, ordinary worker pause barrier left the accepted control pending instead of recovering it before NLU.

contracts.input_authority: User message role + same input text/session/FK + USER_MESSAGE_RECEIVED exact message_id proof + authenticated owner hash; exact existing control vocabulary rechecked
contracts.ordering: Server event sequences, never client timestamps; newest accepted exact controls and newer committed buttons supersede older pending controls
contracts.atomicity: Control revision/completion/continuation committed under session then owned-run lock; completed replay reports applied=False
contracts.task_fence: Before cancelling a non-current task, Root rereads the session and requires the same exact control revision and user_pause, with no await between selecting and cancelling the task

facts: A normal session worker recovers an accepted exact resume before the ordinary pause gate, then executes its saved continuation without NLU
Later committed pause/resume buttons and later accepted controls complete old queued controls as superseded without another revision or source action
Ordinary paused messages remain pending and cannot claim a run; controls beyond the session batch retain an exact-control pre-NLU path
Two independent Store workers recover one control with exactly one applied outcome/revision/continuation
Original expected version is checked; stale accepted control is rejected with the session and saved facts preserved
Message-role, server-event binding and owner-provenance damage is not promoted to a control
Unicode whitespace/case/punctuation candidates match the canonical exact command parser; arbitrary ordinary text is not a control
Completed old pause replay does not cancel a task started after a newer resume
Peer found delayed-applied-pause cancellation race in both direct and recovered hooks; both initial pure failures and new epoch-fenced results are retained

peer_finding.fix: Root _cancel_if_current_pause exact session version/current pause fence

preserved_intermediate.attribution: The test directly awaited private _drain without registering the normal scheduled task; recovery scheduled a concurrent legitimate task. Test now uses normal schedule plus awaiting its task, with all state/source assertions retained.

execution.database: otravel_test; only own rows, own pending negative fixtures retired through Store.fail_run(preserve_session=True)

limits: Targeted qualification does not replace the final merged Root full suite
Shared test DB tests use session-scoped recovery; startup/maintenance call the same bounded Store method globally, with no unrestricted recovery run against unrelated fixture rows
Fault boundaries are controlled durable-row/interleaving tests, not OS kills or arbitrary PostgreSQL/disk failures
No cross-process or external HTTP exactly-once guarantee, no actual LLM/provider or full-dialogue quality claim
